description: Per-lot QC suite results attestation. Required: HPLC purity + IR identity + Karl Fischer water + ICP-MS heavy metal + GC headspace residual solvent + endotoxin LAL. Conditional: NMR identity, PGI LC-MS/MS (chlorpheniramine), microbial limit, sterility (post fill-finish only). Per ADR-2605250515 §Decision 5 + ADR-2605250500 §Decision 3 G2 (ICH Q3/M7 auto-reject) + G9 (witness N≥2: QC analyst + QP-equivalent).

hplcPurityBp.description: HPLC purity in basis points (10000 = 100%). Per USP/JP monograph; DSCG ≥ 9850 (98.5%), naphazoline ≥ 9900 (99.0%), chlorpheniramine ≥ 9950 (99.5%).

kfWaterBp.description: Karl Fischer water content in basis points (10000 = 100%). DSCG: 500-900 (5.0-9.0%); naphazoline / chlorpheniramine: ≤ 100 (1.0%).

gcResidualSolventCompliant.description: ICH Q3C class limits. Class 1 = ND, Class 2 per-solvent limits, Class 3 ≤ 5000 ppm.

pgiLcmsmsNanogPerDay.description: Required for chlorpheniramine (4-chlorobenzyl chloride). PGI exposure in nanograms/day (integer; µg × 1000). Auto-reject if > 1500 (1.5 µg/day, ICH M7 Class 1B).

endotoxinMilliEuPerMl.description: Ophthalmic limit ≤ 1000 (1.0 EU/mL). Milli-EU per mL (integer; EU × 1000).

sterilityCompliant.description: Optional at API stage; required at fill-finish stage for sterile dosage forms only. NA for tablet / topical Wave 1b per ADR-2605250600 §Decision 5.

dissolutionBp30min.description: Wave 1b tablet only (USP <711>). Dissolution % at 30 min in basis points (8000 = 80%). Immediate-release target ≥ 8000 (80%) for most APIs.

dissolutionBp60min.description: Wave 1b tablet only (USP <711>). Dissolution % at 60 min in basis points.

contentUniformityRsdBp.description: Wave 1b tablet only (USP <905>). RSD across 10 units in basis points. Target ≤ 600 (6.0%).

friabilityBpMassLoss.description: Wave 1b uncoated tablet only (USP <1216>). Mass loss after 100 rotations in basis points. Target ≤ 100 (1.0%).

disintegrationTimeSeconds.description: Wave 1b tablet only (USP <701>). Disintegration time in seconds (integer). Uncoated ≤ 1800 (30 min); film-coated ≤ 3600 (60 min).

viscosityMilliCp.description: Wave 1b topical only (cone-plate rheometer at defined shear). Viscosity in milli-centipoise (integer; cP × 1000) for sub-cP precision.

pHValueDeciUnits.description: Wave 1b topical / eye drop only. pH × 10 (integer). pH 5.5 = 55; pH 7.4 = 74. Eye drop typical 45-75 (4.5-7.5); topical gel typical 50-70 (5.0-7.0).

qpEquivalentDid.description: QP-equivalent (薬機法 製造管理者 / EU GMP Qualified Person 相当) DID. Witness invariant N≥2 (G9).
